title: Rhyme: Why Eminem is one of the most impressive lyricists ever
summary: A re-upload of a video breaking down Eminem's rhyme schemes, showing multi-syllable and internal rhymes in songs such as Lose Yourself. It aims to show why he is considered a standout lyricist.
why: Recommended in threads on rap vocabulary and rhyme generation as a clear visual explanation of Eminem's rhyming technique.

quote.text: this absolute standout of a YouTube video about the rhyme scheme in Eminem's Lose Yourself.
